sampling_method: Sequential bounded stream from the official Electronics JSONL.GZ source; stopped after 2,000 retained records.

columns.review_date: ISO date derived from source timestamp (UTC)
columns.product_title: string (empty; not present in review-only source)

transformations: Created stable sequential review IDs because the source review records do not provide a review ID.
Used parent_asin as product_id, falling back to asin only when parent_asin was absent.
SHA-256 hashed source user_id values; original reviewer identifiers were not written to disk.
Converted source millisecond timestamps to UTC ISO dates.
Removed records without meaningful review text, product ID, or reviewer ID.
Removed duplicates by first occurrence of (product_id, anonymized reviewer_id, normalized review_text).
Preserved source rating, title, text, verification flag, and helpful vote values without inventing missing values.
unavailable_fields: product_title is unavailable in the category review-only source and is blank.
A source review ID is unavailable; review_id is locally generated and stable for this preserved sample order.
usage_notes: The dataset includes explicitly marked weak labels from a separate labeling file. They are not verified fraud ground truth; use them only for exploratory analysis unless independently validated.

weak_labels.limitations: Labels are heuristic or manual-review placeholders and must not be used as verified fraud ground truth or proof of authenticity.
